title: BNPL Diamond: 12-Month Standard Term and Flexible Repayment Options
summary: BNPL Diamond defaults to a 12-month standard repayment term if you don’t select a custom schedule. You can choose a flexible term of 7–18 months (whole-month increments); installment schedules are calculated at plan creation and term changes after activation may not be available.
